#!/bin/sh
# realmcradle-managed Barotrauma server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/barotrauma/realmcradle-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
cd "<ROOT>/installs/barotrauma/" || exit 1
exec ./DedicatedServer -name "Test World" -port 27600 -queryport 27601 -maxplayers 8 \
    -public false -password "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" > "<ROOT>/installs/barotrauma/realmcradle-console.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null
